featured.note: Two modes: 'contraindicated in' (11, many labels) and the 'itr' piece of nitrates in sildenafil-family labels (6). The card names both. The nitrate mode is a word piece and a caption should say so. Its 53 is label-over-web selectivity, not a section lift as the shortlist says.
